description: This file defines utility functions for thread management within Apache Spark, including thread pool creation, thread execution, exception handling, and parallel collection processing.

classes.name: AbstractExecutorService
classes.description: An implementation of ExecutorService that runs tasks in the calling thread, used for same-thread executor.

classes.name: BlockingThreadPoolExecutorService
classes.description: Custom thread pool executor with blocking behavior (not detailed in provided code).

methods.name: sameThreadExecutorService
methods.description: Creates an executor service that runs tasks in the same thread.

methods.name: sameThread
methods.description: Returns an execution context that runs tasks in the calling thread.

methods.name: namedThreadFactory
methods.description: Creates a thread factory with a specific name prefix and daemon threads.

methods.name: newDaemonCachedThreadPool
methods.description: Creates a cached thread pool with daemon threads, with optional max thread count.

methods.name: newDaemonFixedThreadPool
methods.description: Creates a fixed thread pool with daemon threads.

methods.name: newDaemonSingleThreadExecutor
methods.description: Creates a single-thread executor with a daemon thread.

methods.name: newDaemonSingleThreadExecutorWithRejectedExecutionHandler
methods.description: Creates a single-thread executor with a custom rejected execution handler.

methods.name: newDaemonBlockingThreadPoolExecutorService
methods.description: Creates a blocking thread pool executor with specified thread count and queue size.

methods.name: newDaemonSingleThreadScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates a scheduled executor with a single daemon thread.

methods.name: newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates a scheduled executor with a single non-daemon thread.

methods.name: newDaemonThreadPoolScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates a scheduled thread pool with daemon threads.

methods.name: runInNewThread
methods.description: Runs code in a new thread and captures exceptions, rethrowing them in the caller thread.

methods.name: wrapCallerStacktrace
methods.description: Adjusts exception stack trace to include caller thread information.

methods.name: newForkJoinPool
methods.description: Creates a ForkJoinPool with a custom thread name prefix.

methods.name: awaitResult
methods.description: Waits for an Awaitable or JFuture to complete, rethrowing exceptions with proper stack trace.

methods.name: awaitReady
methods.description: Waits for an Awaitable to be ready, throwing exception if timeout occurs.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down an ExecutorService within a specified timeout.

methods.name: parmap
methods.description: Transforms a collection in parallel with interruptibility, inheriting thread-local variables.
